metadata.description: Regex pattern matching (similar to REGEXP_LIKE)
examples: SELECT * FROM urls WHERE path RLIKE '^/api/v[0-9]+/'
SELECT * FROM logs WHERE message RLIKE 'ERROR.*\d{3}'

metadata.name: NOT RLIKE
metadata.description: Negated regex pattern matching
examples: SELECT * FROM emails WHERE subject NOT RLIKE '^Re:'
SELECT * FROM files WHERE name NOT RLIKE '\.(jpg|png|gif)$'

metadata.name: SET_SEARCH

parameters.description: Value to search, set to search in

metadata.description: Searches for a value in a set
examples: SELECT * FROM products WHERE SET_SEARCH(category, allowed_categories)
